input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: No non-compete, exclusivity, field-of-use or territory covenant binds AP anywhere in the Agreement. Searches for "compet", "exclusiv" and "shall not" surface only Kubient-side warranties, AP's own content/creative standards, forum-selection and IP-ownership language — none restricting AP's businesses, purchases or development. Section 1 affirmatively disclaims exclusivity and confirms AP may offer or sell Inventory through other agents or third parties, which matches the preferred position (no restriction on Customer). No redline required.
